scope: The reported groups execute actual MIPS functions against the pre-refactor ELF: city/battle input, decimal input, pagination, animation timing, search outcomes, skill dispatch, attack preparation and soft-float boundary/random cases. Compares return, observable state, input consumption and rendering calls. Rendering/modal boundaries are deterministic models; not native firmware or hardware. Intentional viewport/HUD presentation changes use common modeled drawing boundaries; display scrolling, clipping and footer pixels are checked separately.
